He is a very nice person and it's seen that he is passionate about this course. He is very student-friendly, to the extent that it causes complications in the organization and the discipline of the course. Since he is new to Bilkent, he doesn't really know how things work, the structure of exams and the grading systems, etc. However, he was always very eager to learn, but still, his lack of experience in Bilkent caused some people to exploit his goodwill. He left most of the final decisions to students, while this was a very valuable thing, it would've been better if he could actually reach out and make the final decisions by talking to the course coordinator or other faculty members rather than students at large.

I can tell the instructor has immense knowledge and passion for the subject, however, the course seemed rather disorganized in that the instructor would just leave the class to decide on some critical matters which led to huge discussions and disagreements within the students. Professor is very respectful and kind; He is very positive, with the intention to teach the class some useful information; however he was not effective in structuring this course at all. Firstly, for assignment weights, types, he wanted the class collectively agree on it. There are at least 64 people in this class, how can we all agree on one idea about assignment and grading? yes, he gives the freedom of opinion, but this is not the right context for it. Secondly, he got angry for low participation and wanted to report it to university, but what else to expect when instructor himself agrees to take the recording of classes and not to take attendance/ no requirement to open camera? this is not justified in my opinion. Thirdly, yes, as its his first time teaching in bilkent, he did not know anything about curve/catalogue grading, but as for being instructor, he should at least familiarize himself with these concepts before giving the class. Moreover, about the class content, I wish we could see more global marketing examples, this field is so broad and interesting, but why we had only examples from Indian context? Course is very biased in this term. I expected more, I did not learn anything i did not know before, and i truly regret taking this course

I think the course was not structured at all, and the grading system, additional workload, etc. were decided later in the semester. While I understand it's because the professor doesn't know about the system, he should've at least been told how it works, I think both sides (professor and the faculty) are at fault here. At first, it was just midterm and final (50-50%) as the grading material, and we reached out for additional grading criteria as a group project to have a more fair-weighted grading system. This shouldn't have been left to students in my opinion. The midterm structure was unlike the standard we've been used to by now, and I have doubts about whether this structure works or not. Also the course schedule being in the evening between 6.30-9.20 p.m. was difficult regarding attendance and overall focus on the course. On the positive side, I think this is a very valuable and interesting course that all management students should take, and the later-added project topics were unique and interesting and the workload and the deadline for the project were very reasonable. If the course is organized and structured efficiently beforehand and not during the semester, I think it'll be one of the go-to courses in the curriculum.

He is definitely a principled person. From what I heard from a friend who took his class in the previous term, there was one midterm and one final, and the course was conducted online. However, this term, there is a noticeable change in his approach, which I think has improved the effectiveness of the course. He explains the course content exceptionally well and is undoubtedly one of the best marketing professors. He makes the subject very engaging, and you truly understand the material when you listen to him. He also uses a lot of resources in his lectures. However, we struggled to understand what he expected from us for the term project. His instructions were not very clear, which made things much more difficult for us, especially when dealing with multiple exams and presentations for different courses. I wish his guidance had been clearer. Also, at the beginning of the term, he was very strict about lateness and wouldn’t let latecomers into the class. But by the end of the term, this attitude changed, and he started allowing even those who arrived 10 minutes late. Unfortunately, this created a sense of unfairness for those who came to campus just for this class and were not allowed in earlier in the term. However, I am certain that he is a very kind and knowledgeable person, and I really like him and I would recommend everyone who likes marketing to take his course.

Genel olarak sınıfça hocamızın bu durumundan fazlasıyla rahatsızlık duyduk.

Dönemin başından sonuna kadar attığım her maile özveriyle cevap vererek hiç geciktirmeden dönüş sağladı ve her zaman açıklayıcı olarak kafamızda hiç soru işareti kalmayana kadar bıkmadan açıklama yapmaya devam etti. Projede takıldığımızda bize yol gösterecek şekilde davrandı. Derse katılım sağlayamadı, proje veya sınavda ne beklediğini asla aktarmadı. Syllabus koymadı. Ders işleyiş hızını düzgün ayarlayamadığı için sınavı ders gününden başka bir gün yapmak zorunda kaldık. Projede ne yapacağımız, ne zamana yapacağımız son dakikaya kadar belli olmadı. Sınav notlandırırken notlandırma mantığını düzgün bir şekilde açıklamadı, bazı itirazlarımıza "ben öyle dediğim için" benzeri ifadelerle cevap verip, yanıtsız bıraktı. Yine ders işleyiş hızını ayarlayamadığı için proje sunumlarını son ders yapmak yerine final sınavları döneminde bir gün yapılacak şekilde ayarladı. Birçok konuyu aktaramadı, derslerin çoğunluğunda öğrenci katılımı olmadan kendi kendine konuştu. Katılım olmayınca da trip atar tavırlarla geçiştirdi.

Öğretim üyesi derslerin zamanında başlayıp zamanında bitmesi için iyi bir organizasyon ve planlama yapmıştır ancak ders içerisinde konu hakkında eğer öğrenci %100 doğru cevabı vererek sadece yorum yaptığında "lütfen yorum yapmayalım" diye öğrencinin sözünü ve dersi anlamaya çalışma sürecini yarıda bırakmaktadır. İlk derste "burada doğru diye bir kavram yok, herkes istediğini söylemekte özgür" tarzında açık iletişime yer vermeye çalışırken ilerleyen haftalarda bu şekilde tam tersi bir tavırda bulunması öğrencinin motivasyonunu oldukça olumsuz etkilemektedir ve derse devamlılığı, öğrenme derinliğini sağlıklı sürdürebilmekte sorunlar çıkarmaktadır. Sınav notlarındaki puanlamanın arkasındaki mantığı da sormak istediğimizde "bu şekilde olması gerekiyordu" tarzında cevap verip öğrencinin anlamadığı noktaları açıklamamaktadır.

Bölümdeki en merak ettiğim derslerden biri, gerçekten belki hayatımda tekrar dersini almayacağım derslerden biri idi Marketing. Fakat bu hevesle başladığım yolculuk, çok büyük bir hayal kırıklığına dönüştü. Derse dair en ufak bir hevesim kalmadı. Bütün dönem tek beklediğim dersin bitmesi oldu. Sınav değerlendirmelerindeki oldukça sert puanlandırma, kalan emeklerimin de boşa gittiğini gösterdi. Case'leri aktif okuyan, derse katılım göstermeye çalışan ben, dönem sonunda arkada oturup işlerimi halletmeye vakit ayırdım ne yazık ki. Ders içeriği bulunmasına ve Hocanın konu geçmemeye çalışmasına rağmen durum o kadar vahim bir duruma dönüştü ki, sınıfın yaklaşık %70-%75'i derslere katılmamaya başladı. Maalesef ki bir Hoca'nın durup, nerede yanlış yapıyorum diye kendini değerlendirmesi gerek diye düşünüyorum.
